NEX FY25: Gross revenue $133,701k (100% basis), NPI $102,252k (100% basis). FCT owns 50% effective interest. Revenue/NPI are on 100% basis per footnote 13 on p68.
Waterway Point FY25: Gross revenue $86,183k (100% basis), NPI $64,484k (100% basis). FCT owns 50% interest. On 100% basis per footnote 13 on p68.

FY25 figures for Changi City Point: Gross revenue $42k, property expenses ($210k), NPI $252k. These are post-divestment adjustments (divested Oct 2023). Included in consolidated totals but not in active property list.
FCT completed an Equity Fund Raising in April 2025, partly to fund the NPCSW acquisition. Units in issue grew from ~1,817.5m to ~2,034.9m (p184/p186). Net dilution impact on DPU noted.

Annual shopper traffic: NEX 37.9m, Northpoint City 58.6m, Causeway Point 27.3m, Waterway Point 25.5m, Tampines 1 17.0m, Tiong Bahru Plaza 16.6m, Century Square 14.5m, Hougang Mall 10.9m, White Sands 10.3m.

As at 30 Sep 2025, FCT has $198,418k of perpetual securities outstanding (p149). These are deducted from net assets to arrive at net assets attributable to unitholders ($4,543,451k). Issued in FY25, first perpetual securities for FCT.

2H FY25 DPU of 6.059 cents comprises 0.096 cents (1 Apr 2025 to 3 Apr 2025) + 5.963 cents (4 Apr 2025 to 30 Sep 2025). The 0.096 cents period relates to units pre-EFR; 5.963 cents for post-EFR period with enlarged unit base.

parsing_traps.trap: Performance.portfolio_value vs audited consolidated investment properties
parsing_traps.detail: p7 headline '$8.2 billion Total Portfolio Property Value' includes proportionate JV interests (FCT 50% NEX + FCT 50% WP). The audited consolidated portfolio statement shows $6,449.0m (wholly owned) plus JV equity value of $1,042,638k (book/carrying). parsing_traps.resolution: Flagged as inferred. The $8.2bn is derived from $6,449.0m + $1,070.5m (50% NEX fair value) + $665.5m (50% WP fair value) = $8,185.0m ≈ $8.2bn.
